That has been true for decades.

More jobs hired means a stronger country. That was your assumption going into Thursday morning.

Then 8:30 hit.

caption:
America added 162,000 jobs last month and your investments fell because of it. Here is why. 📉

Cover shows the 8:30 AM cross-cut: two alerts, jobs up and portfolio down, both caused by the same number. Slide 2 covers what everyone believed the morning before the report dropped. Slide 3 is the exact sequence, second by second. Slide 4 explains why five years of two-percent-plus inflation rewired what good news means for your savings. Slide 5 is the Kobeissi Letter post that reached 1.9 million views. Slide 6 is the irony, and what business owners who stopped waiting for the economy are doing differently. Slide 7 is the checklist, save it.

Sixty straight months of inflation trained investors to punish strong hiring. A good jobs report now wipes out ordinary savings while workers celebrate. The businesses winning right now do not wait for the economy to cooperate. Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we will show you what that looks like for yours.

Sources: The Kobeissi Letter

story.title: The system is broken. You know the system is broken when stocks FALL after the US unexpectedly adds +162,000 jobs in a month, TRIPLING expectations. Why? Because a strong jobs report means a higher chance of rate hikes.
